Higher Education Committee
Tuesday, April 16, 2024
3:00 PM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: Senator Erin P. Murphy

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:11pm

Call to order

S.F. 5326: Senator Fateh: Higher education licensure and grant provisions funding and related policy changes establishment.

The following individuals testified on S.F.5326:
-Nekey Oliver, Director of Government Relations and
Community Engagement, Office of Higher Education

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 5326, be laid over.

S.F. 4635: Senator Kupec: Peace officer skills training tuition removal.
Senator Putnam moved the A-1 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

The following individuals testified on S.F.4635:

-Deric Swenson, Moorhead Police Department

-Brianna Mitchell, student, M State Moorhead

-Binyad Brifki, student, M State Moorhead

-Vicente Amoles, student, M State Moorhead

-Jeff Nelson, instructor, M State Moorhead

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 4635, be laid over.

S.F. 3806: Senator Kupec: Matching funds provision to institutions for childcare programs.
Senator Putnam moved the A2 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Gavel was transferred to Senator Putnam at 3:42pm

The following individuals testified on S.F.3806:

-Andi Carter, student, Minneapolis Community and

Technical College

-Karina Villeda, student, University of Minnesota

-John Runningen, President, LeadMN

-Inam Al-Hammouri, Start Early Funders Coalition

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 3806, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 3:47pm

aa ——

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer, Legislative Kssistant
